description: Implement named pure functions for call pot odds, required equity, zero-equity bluff break-even fold rate, branch EV, MDF, polarized river bluff proportions, and sensitivity to rake.
acceptance_criteria: Each formula states units, pot timing convention, assumptions, and domain restrictions.
Tests include hand-calculated examples and algebraic identities.
Invalid states such as negative pot/call or impossible probabilities are rejected.

planning.title: Implement pot odds, break-even, EV, MDF, and bluff/value formulas
